fusions.name: Stoop From Height
fusions.desc: Rises and hurls an edge down at a target up to 7 tiles away, dealing 25 damage, up to 2 times that at the far end of its reach. It ignores armour.

fusions.name: Downbeat Chop
fusions.desc: Chops down in a circle as your wings come down, dealing 7 damage to every enemy within 2.5 tiles. It holds 3 charges and kills give charges back. You move 10% faster for 2 seconds after it.

fusions.name: Rise to Swing
fusions.desc: Lifts you 2 tiles from where you stood and increases your critical damage by 30% for 12 seconds.

fusions.name: Carried Momentum
fusions.desc: Once you have covered enough ground, your physical damage rises by 25% for 4 seconds. Once every 8 seconds.
